text: Reach and frequency don't add up across ads, so the account's Reach and Frequency key numbers need an account-level figure for this window and read n/a; none was supplied. Each ad's own frequency still shows on its card and in its detail. To get the key numbers: pull account-level reach and frequency for the same window and add them when you rebuild this report.
Graded against this account's own ads, never benchmarks.
Metric ids and formulas are defined in creative-context/references/metrics.md.
Account: Acme Outdoor Co.
Data source: Ads Manager export. Window: 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-30. Attribution: not stated. Money is shown in USD.
Completeness: not reconciled.
Basis: graded against this account's own ads of the same campaign objective, never a benchmark.

Grouped by: format, ad type, widening when a group has under 5 comparable ads. Comparable ads per group used: account-wide (sales) n=30, carousel (sales) n=7, static (sales) n=7, ugc-video (sales) n=9, ugc-video / bau (sales) n=6
Bands: top quartile is at or above p75, bottom at or below p25 (costs inverted: a cheap CPM is top).
Ads under 1000 impressions are not graded (arbitrary default: set it from your own spend per ad).
CTR uses: link clicks. Conversions column: Purchases.
Objective: not in the data (or not a known objective) for 30 ads, so they are graded as sales. Add an objective column to grade each ad on its own goal.
Payback is read by objective: sales: cost per sale and return on ad spend.
24 of 30 ads were graded in a wider group than format / ad type because the narrower one had under 5 comparable ads (each ad's own reason is in --json); the group column shows where each was graded.
WARNING small comparison groups (fewer than twice the 5-ad minimum, so a grade there is an early read): carousel (sales), static (sales), ugc-video (sales), ugc-video / bau (sales).
Verdict settings used (arbitrary defaults, set them from your own account): young-days=5, window=6, min-impressions=1000, min-change=8.0%, top-n=3, grouped by format,ad type.

Dashboard settings used: cards per list (--top-n) 8, Pareto cut (--pareto-share) 80% (a common convention, not a rule), concentration counts the top 3 ads, previews capped at 240 KB each and 3600 KB in total.
Funnel columns beyond the standard fields: checkouts: no matching column; landing page views: no matching column (matched by normalised header).

Format, White space and Briefing settings (arbitrary defaults): formats graded against each other only with 3 or more; heatmaps show the top 18 concepts; 3 example ads per format and 3 video ads in the retention chart; brief starters use the top 3 gaps and top 2 Iterate ads; the copy table lists the top 8 ads.

Video retention columns (matched by normalised header): Video plays at 25%: read from column 'Video plays at 25%'; Video plays at 50%: read from column 'Video plays at 50%'; Video plays at 75%: read from column 'Video plays at 75%'; Video plays at 95%: read from column 'Video plays at 95%'; Video plays at 100%: read from column 'Video plays at 100%'; average watch time: read from column 'Video average play time'.
Ad copy columns: primary text: not found; headline: not found; call to action: not found.
Breakdown file: not supplied.
Briefs: starters built from the gaps and Iterate verdicts, no briefs file.
Reach and frequency: not shown, they need an account-level pull.
Prior period: not supplied.

Chart settings (arbitrary defaults, set them from your own account): rolling averages cover 7 days and need 5 days with data; a format-week with fewer than 1,000 impressions is left off its line; new ad-age buckets start at 7, 16, 33 and 66 days.

Industry figures: Lebesgue, Facebook Ads Creatives Benchmarks (2024), https://lebesgue.io/facebook-ads/facebook-ads-creatives-benchmarks-and-best-practices; Billo, Hook to Hold (2026), https://billo.app/blog/hook-rate-to-hold-rate/. Shown as context beside your own numbers; they never change a grade, verdict or the order of what to do first.
Ad images: previews embedded 30, thumbnails used 0, placeholders 0 (reasons: none), 301.6 KB embedded in total, each image once.
